newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sui Chong buys HK$110.74 mln properties.
newsitem.headline: Sui Chong buys HK$110.74 mln properties.

text.p: Sui Chong Holdings Ltd said on Monday it had agreed to buy commercial properties from its 58.8-percent controlling shareholder Winfoong International Ltd for HK$110.74 million.

Sui Chong said the properties would include 40 carparking spaces in Shatin in Hong Kong's New Territories, and an aggregate 39,300 square feet shopping area in Kwan Yick Building in the western part of Hong Kong Island.
The purchase will provide the company with a steady income stream and will enhance its earnings base, Sui Chong said.
